What We’re Building
UserKeeper is a mobile safety app that helps people stay connected and
respond quickly in emergency situations.
The app allows users to:
Share their location with trusted contacts
Send emergency alerts instantly
Receive notifications when something is wrong
Stay connected even in low-connectivity environments

What’s Next (Roadmap)
With your support, we plan to move forward with development:
April 2026 – Finalize prototype and core features
May 2026 – Closed beta testing with early backers
June 2026 – Public beta release
July 2026 – Full launch and ongoing improvements
How It Works
UserKeeper is designed to work reliably by combining standard mobile
technologies with alternative communication approaches in low-
connectivity environments.
Our goal is to ensure that important alerts and location data can still reach
trusted contacts even when network conditions are unstable.
Why This Matters
We believe no one should feel alone in critical moments.
UserKeeper is built to give people peace of mind and a simple way to stay
connected when it matters most.
How We’ll Use the Funds
Your support will help us:
Complete app development
Improve reliability and testing
Build secure infrastructure
Launch and maintain the platform

Risks and challenges
Risks and Challenges
Every project has challenges, and we want to be transparent with our
backers.
1. Technical Development
• Risk: Building a secure, decentralized app with offline capabilities is
complex.
• Our Plan: We have an experienced team in app development, blockchain,
and AI. We have already built prototypes and tested core features. We will
follow a clear roadmap and iterative testing to ensure functionality.
2. Scaling & Server Reliability
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/138156617/userkeeper-emergency-safety-app-for-everyone?ref=discover_saved_projects&category_id=332 6/10

7/13/26, 2:49 PM UserKeeper — Emergency Safety App for Everyone by Bogdan Beryslavskyy — Kickstarter
• Risk: Ensuring the app works reliably for a growing number of users.
• Our Plan: We are implementing mesh networking and cloud-based
backup systems. Early backers will help us test scalability before public
launch.
3. User Adoption & Education
• Risk: Users may need guidance to use advanced features like offline
tracking and secure alerts.
• Our Plan: We will provide clear tutorials, onboarding flows, and customer
support to ensure everyone can use the app easily.
4. Regulatory & Privacy Considerations
• Risk: Location-based apps must comply with privacy laws in different
regions.
• Our Plan: We built UserKeeper with privacy-first principles. All data is
encrypted and decentralized, and we will consult legal experts to ensure
compliance.
Our Commitment:
We are fully committed to delivering a safe, reliable, and innovative
UserKeeper app. By backing this project, you are helping us test, improve,
and launch a product that will make safety accessible to everyone.
Learn about accountability on Kickstarter
Use of AI
UserKeeper incorporates AI to enhance user safety. AI analyzes location
data in real time and generates smart alerts and recommendations for
users. This helps the app respond quickly to potential safety risks while
keeping all data secure and private. All app development, design, and core
functionality is created by our human team. AI is used only as a tool to
improve user experience.
